chunks: Of what are they asking one another?
ai.seo_question: What are the disbelievers asking one another about in Surah Al-Mutaffifin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a rhetorical question highlighting the persistent doubt and idle speculation of the Quraysh regarding the reality of the Hereafter. It sets the stage for the detailed critique of their moral corruption, particularly their deceit in trade, which serves as a microcosm of their spiritual deficiency and rejection of divine truth.
